title: Pharmacy Benefits Note: Medicare Member Credit on a Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual Switch (Delivery & Pickup Services)
content:
The Medicare member credit of a switch into Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual under Delivery & Pickup Services depends on the patient's primary prescription insurance record in active status, as held under Prescription Insurance on File. The credit is taken off the switch charge.

| Patient's primary prescription insurance record in active status | Medicare member credit |
|---|---|
| Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Plan | $3.00 |
| Medicare Part D Standard Plan | $1.50 |
| Medicare Part D Enhanced Plan | $1.50 |
| any other class of record, or none | nothing |

Only the record that is the patient's primary coverage and in active status is read.

## Hypothetical cases

- Primary active record Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Plan: $3.00.
- Primary active record Medicare Part D Enhanced Plan, with a Commercial Copay Plan as secondary: $1.50.
- Primary active record Medicaid Managed Care Pharmacy Benefit: nothing.
- A Medicare Part D Standard Plan record that has been terminated, and no other primary record in active status: nothing.
